card.name: Words just before plastic or bag
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected 'plastic', 'bag' or covering word, such as 'normal', 'sterile', 'grocery', 'zipped plastic' or 'cover ... with'. It also fires on 'plastic' itself when 'bag' or another item word is likely next.

modes.description: A modifier or the word plastic where bag, package or film comes next.

modes.label: Covering and dressing words
modes.description: A linking word before a dressing or cap in instructions about covering skin.
modes.example: Cover the treated area<< with>> gauze dressing if desired.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward plastic and bag words as the next word.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name a plastic bag, wrap or covering.
